name: SSL Labs: alert on grade drop or expiring certificate

parameters.content:
## Grade drop and certificate expiry alerts
Two SSL Labs Triggers watch the same hosts every 6 hours. One fires once when a grade falls below A (and re-arms when it recovers). The other fires once per certificate that expires within 21 days.

The first poll only records a baseline and emits nothing. Swap the Slack node for Telegram, email or WhatsApp and reuse the same message expression.
